Using PRC-2026.1 provisionally is a disclosed choice, and whether it was the right policy is checked elsewhere. Every figure the agent uses appears in the evidence or follows from it by arithmetic: costs (FACT-cost), volume and transactions (FACT-volume, FACT-transactions), the 26% mid minimum (PRC-2026.1§3), the 2.45% + $0.20 mid list rate (PRC-2026.1§2), the 12% discount threshold (PRC-2026.1§4), the $4M deal_desk threshold (PRC-2026.1§5), SPRING26 expiring 2026-06-30 (PRC-2026.1§6), and cfo_delegate approval for strategic exceptions (PRC-2026.1§7). The 'lowest whole basis point' claim also checks out: 2.07% gives about a 25.9% margin, below the minimum. The requested rate and the 'strategic pricing' statement are correctly labeled as the merchant's unverified claims (FACT-request). The exception is described as requested but not approved, matching FACT-exception. One point for analysts to note: pricing_desk routing is listed in the summary but not justified. PRC-2026.1§8 requires pricing_desk only when cost data is missing, and here cost data is present.
